items.reason: The shared try/catch lets one SendGrid cancellation failure abort remaining cancellations and skip database deletions.
Deferring SendGrid cancellation to the cron allows reminders to be delivered before cancellation runs or after the provider's cancellation cutoff.

This reports missing database cleanup after immediate cancellation, distinct from #11's misleading naming. Its claim that rows are never cleaned up is overstated: the cron deletes email reminder rows once their scheduled date passes.
